features.name: Create event
steps: Create an event named Project Planning on September 15, 2026 from 10:00 AM to 11:30 AM on the primary calendar, then verify that it appears at the correct time in Week view.
features.expected: Event must appear at the correct time (10:00-11:30 AM, Sep 15, 2026) in Week view.

features.name: Create event
steps: Create an all-day event named Company Offsite on September 18, 2026 and verify that it appears in the all-day section instead of an hourly time slot.
features.expected: All-day event must appear in the all-day section, not in an hourly slot.

features.name: Event details
steps: Create an event named Client Review with a specific start time, end time, location, and description. Reopen the saved event and verify that all four values were preserved.
features.expected: Title, start, end, location, and description must all be preserved after reopening.

features.name: Event details
steps: Edit an existing event by changing its title, start time, end time, and location without creating a second event. Verify that only the original event remains.
features.expected: Edits must update the original event without creating a second one.

features.name: Event details
steps: Move an existing event from its original date and time to a different day and time, then verify that the original slot is empty and the event appears only at the new time.
features.expected: Original slot must be empty; the event appears only at the new date and time.

features.name: Delete event
steps: Delete a specified non-recurring event and verify that it no longer appears on the calendar while unrelated events remain unchanged.
features.expected: Deleted event must no longer appear; unrelated events remain unchanged.

features.name: Repeat
steps: Create an event named Weekly Review that repeats every Monday at 9:00 AM for one hour. Verify that multiple future occurrences appear on Mondays.
features.expected: Weekly recurrence must produce multiple future Monday occurrences at 9:00 AM.

features.name: Custom recurrence
steps: Create a recurring event named Training Session that repeats every two weeks on Tuesday and Thursday and ends on a specified date. Verify both the weekday pattern and the recurrence end boundary.
features.expected: Bi-weekly Tuesday/Thursday recurrence must show the correct weekday pattern and end at the specified boundary.

features.name: Recurring event
steps: Modify only one occurrence of an existing recurring event by moving it two hours later. Verify that the selected occurrence changes while the rest of the series keeps its original time.
features.expected: Moving one occurrence must change only that occurrence; the rest of the series keeps its original time.

features.name: Recurring event
steps: Edit an occurrence in the middle of a recurring series and apply the new start time to that occurrence and all following events without changing earlier occurrences. Verify both sides of the boundary.
features.expected: Editing a middle occurrence must apply to it and following occurrences only; earlier ones unchanged.

features.name: Recurring event
steps: Change the title and duration of an entire recurring series and verify that all occurrences in the series reflect the update.
features.expected: Series-wide title and duration changes must reflect in all occurrences.

features.name: Notifications
steps: Add two notifications to an event: one 30 minutes before the event and another one day before it. Save the event, reopen it, and verify that both notification rules remain configured.
features.expected: Both notification rules (30 minutes before, 1 day before) must remain configured after reopening.

features.name: Event visibility
steps: Create an event and set its visibility to Private while keeping the event marked as Busy. Reopen it and verify both settings.
features.expected: Private visibility and Busy status must both be saved and shown after reopening.

features.name: Event visibility
steps: Change an existing event from Busy to Free without changing its title, date, or time, and verify that the event retains all unrelated properties.
features.expected: Changing Busy to Free must not alter title, date, or time.

features.name: Event color
steps: Assign a distinct event color to a specified event without changing the color of the calendar itself, then verify that another event on the same calendar keeps its previous appearance.
features.expected: Event color change must not affect the calendar color or other events' appearance.

features.name: Create new calendar
steps: Create a new calendar named Product Launch with a description and the specified time zone. Verify that it appears under the user's calendar list.
features.expected: New calendar must appear under the user's calendar list with the specified description and time zone.

features.name: Calendar settings
steps: Rename the Product Launch calendar to Launch Program, change its description, and verify that existing events in that calendar remain intact.
features.expected: Renaming and description changes must not affect existing events in the calendar.

features.name: Calendar
steps: Create one event in the primary calendar and another event in Launch Program at different times. Toggle the visibility of Launch Program and verify that only its event disappears from the current view.
features.expected: Toggling visibility must hide/show only that calendar's event; others remain visible.

features.name: Calendar
steps: Move an existing event from the primary calendar to Launch Program without duplicating it. Verify that the event belongs to the destination calendar and no duplicate remains in the source calendar.
features.expected: Moved event must belong to the destination calendar with no duplicate in the source.

features.name: Time zone
steps: Configure a secondary time zone in Calendar settings while retaining the existing primary time zone. Return to the calendar and verify that the secondary time scale is displayed without changing event timestamps.
features.expected: Secondary time zone must display without changing event timestamps.

features.name: Event details / Time zone
steps: Create an event using a time zone different from the calendar's primary time zone, save it, and verify that Calendar displays the corresponding local time correctly in the primary calendar view.
features.expected: Event created in a different time zone must display the correct local time in the primary calendar view.

features.name: Calendar settings / Notifications
steps: Configure the selected calendar so timed events receive a default notification 30 minutes before the event, then create a new event and verify that the default notification is inherited.
features.expected: New timed events must inherit the 30-minute default notification.

features.name: Calendar settings / Notifications
steps: Configure a separate default notification rule for all-day events and verify that a newly created all-day event inherits that rule without affecting timed-event notification defaults.
features.expected: All-day events must inherit their own default rule without affecting timed-event defaults.

features.name: Appointment schedule
steps: Create an appointment schedule named Consultation with a 30-minute appointment duration and recurring availability from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Monday through Friday. Verify the generated availability blocks before saving.
features.expected: Availability blocks (9:00-5:00, Mon-Fri, 30-min) must generate correctly before saving.

features.name: Appointment schedule
steps: Create an appointment schedule with different availability periods on different weekdays, including one weekday with two separate availability windows and another weekday marked unavailable.
features.expected: Different weekday availability, including a two-window day and an unavailable day, must save correctly.

features.name: Scheduling window
steps: Configure an appointment schedule so appointments can only be booked within a limited future scheduling window and require a minimum lead time before the appointment. Verify both constraints in the saved schedule configuration.
features.expected: Scheduling window and minimum lead time must both be saved and reflected in the configuration.

features.name: Adjusted availability
steps: Start with a recurring weekday appointment schedule, then override one specific date so that only a shortened availability window is offered on that date while the normal weekly schedule remains unchanged.
features.expected: Adjusted availability must apply only to the overridden date; the normal weekly schedule remains unchanged.

features.name: Check calendars for availability
steps: Configure an appointment schedule to check selected calendars for conflicts. Create a conflicting calendar event inside an otherwise available period and verify that the conflicting time is excluded from appointment availability.
features.expected: Conflicting calendar events must be excluded from appointment availability.

features.name: Appointment schedule
steps: Change an existing appointment schedule from 60-minute appointments to 30-minute appointments and modify its weekly availability. Verify that both duration and availability are updated without creating a second schedule.
features.expected: Duration change (60 to 30 minutes) and availability updates must apply to the same schedule, not create a second one.

features.name: Appointment schedule
steps: Configure an appointment schedule with recurring weekly availability, an adjusted availability exception, a scheduling window, and calendar conflict checking. Save it, reopen the schedule, and verify that all four layers of configuration were preserved correctly.
features.expected: All four layers (weekly availability, exception, window, conflict checking) must persist after reopening.
